Method of Attack: Buffer overflow stemming from the use of an unsafe variable in the Trusted Platform Module (TPM) configuration
Execution of malicious code within the UEFI firmware during runtime
Impacted Systems: Phoenix SecureCore firmware running on select Intel processor families, including Alder Lake, Coffee Lake, Comet Lake, Ice Lake, Jasper Lake, Kaby Lake, Meteor Lake, Raptor Lake, Rocket Lake, and Tiger Lake
Attack Vector: Local attacker escalating privileges to gain code execution within the UEFI firmware
